# freshdesk_ticket_form (Data Source)

Look up a single ticket form by ID, including its fields.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_ticket_form" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the ticket form to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the form was created (RFC 3339).
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the fallback form.
- `description` (String) Text shown beneath the title.
- `fields` (String) The form's fields, as JSON.
- `name` (String) Internal name of the form.
- `title` (String) Heading shown above the form.
- `updated_at` (String) When the form was last changed (RFC 3339).
